drafts.subject: URGENT: Product Recall Notification - Salmonella
drafts.body: Please immediately pull and hold all fresh whole slicer cucumbers, 24-count cartons associated with lot code L32611596 due to a Salmonella hazard. We will confirm next steps by phone shortly.

drafts.subject: Product Recall Notification: Fresh Whole Slicer Cucumbers
drafts.body: This is a recall notification for fresh whole slicer cucumbers, 24-count cartons, due to Salmonella. Affected lot codes are L32611610. For locations #203 Watsonville, #204 Salinas, #205 Seaside, #206 Gilroy, #208 Marina, and #209 Carmel, immediately pull and hold all product. The distributor will confirm next steps by phone.

drafts.subject: URGENT: Product Recall Notification - Fresh Whole Slicer Cucumbers
drafts.body: This notification concerns fresh whole slicer cucumbers, 24-count cartons, due to a Salmonella hazard. The affected lot code is L32611596. Pine & Prairie Grocers #311 Woodland must immediately PULL and HOLD all inventory associated with this lot. Please hold all product pending confirmation. Our food-safety lead will contact you by phone shortly to confirm next steps.

drafts.subject: Urgent: Salmonella Recall Notification - Fresh Whole Slicer Cucumbers
drafts.body: This notification concerns fresh whole slicer cucumbers (24-count cartons) due to a Salmonella hazard. Affected lot codes are L32611596 and L32611610. All listed locations (Corner Basket #12 Oakland, #13 Berkeley, #14 Fremont, #15 Hayward, #17 Richmond, #19 Concord) must immediately PULL and HOLD all product associated with these lots. Please hold pending confirmation. We will confirm next steps via phone shortly.

drafts.subject: Product Recall Notification: Fresh Whole Slicer Cucumbers
drafts.body: This is a recall notification for fresh whole slicer cucumbers, 24-count cartons, due to Salmonella. Affected lot code is L32611610. Lakeview Markets #501 Reno must PULL this product. Lakeview Markets #506 Minden must PULL this product. Please pull and hold all affected product immediately. Our distributor will confirm these actions via phone shortly.
